summary: The Corporate Energy Buyers Association answers in support of the MISO abeyance motion, saying 90 days allows stakeholder work and avoids moving the debate to the FERC docket.
ask: Grant the MISO and Transmission Owners abeyance motion in an expedited manner.

points.point: CEBA says abeyance gives time for collaboration instead of a rushed proposal that shifts debate into the docket.
points.quote: as opposed to a rushed proposal that would unnecessarily shift stakeholder debate to the Commission docket.

points.point: CEBA says 90 days would not materially slow reform.
points.quote: a 90-day extension would not materially impede the Commission’s objectives for advancing reforms quickly

points.point: CEBA asks for expedited grant, tied to MISO's mid-November filings.
points.quote: CEBA respectfully requests that the Commission grant the motion in an expedited manner.

throughLine.text: Supports the 90-day abeyance of the E-8 60-day show cause deadline; FERC granted the motion on August 14, 2026.
